FN-G3JWS66-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 483
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Bryan Brinyark
Tourism
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/23/2026
House Bill 483 as introduced could increase recording fee receipts collected by probate judges
and deposited into county general funds and filing fee receipts collected by the Secretary of
State (SOS) and deposited into Secretary of State Entity Fund by undetermined amounts
dependent upon the number of decentralized unincorporated nonprofit associations formed in
the state, pursuit to this bill.
